common-setup.set: valid, editable, test-owned Set; reset per independent trial
common-setup.signal_path: isolated enabled device in active track/chain; route named input/MIDI source into it, with monitoring active when needed; explicit 4/4, 120 BPM and 48 kHz chosen as authored setups, not product limits
common-setup.neutralization: disable unrelated automation, mapping, randomization and effects except when named; set gain and wet output nonzero/unmuted; all values used as interior controls must first be admitted by target UI
common-setup.references: use owned disposable copies for destructive/replacement/malformed cases; never change immutable source artifacts

positive-signal-guard.enabled: tested control/section enabled, correct mode, active routing and explicit nonzero amount/depth/send/feedback when testing its influence
positive-signal-guard.baseline: first demonstrate the relevant wet path responds to the test stimulus in a paired positive case; no effect caused by disabled control, zero amount, silence, missing notes, muted channel or dry-only output is evidence
positive-signal-guard.negative_cases: documented zero/disabled exception uses separate nonzero/enabled positive baseline, changes only the targeted setting, and leaves expected signal/comparator null unless independently supplied
positive-signal-guard.stereo: use equal samples in both channels only when dual-mono is specified; LFO channel equality is never generalized to audio equality from distinct stereo inputs
positive-signal-guard.random: no seed, distribution, sequence matching or expectation of identical repeated output is asserted
positive-signal-guard.safety: test-owned bounded low-amplitude source; high-feedback stability is not a grade or a claim

authored_audio.dual_mono: four seconds; left=right=0.125*sin(2*pi*440*t); 48000 frames/s; silence before/after; this formula defines analyst input only
authored_audio.amplitude_steps: 440 Hz dual-mono tone, amplitude 0.03125 for first two seconds, 0.125 next two; separate silence/held-tone segments for onset tests
authored_audio.broadband: owned deterministic multitone 60, 440, 880 and 2400 Hz, each amplitude 0.025; finite 200 ms bursts at 0,1,2,3 seconds; intended bands must be confirmed active in target
authored_audio.phrases: distinct analyst-owned A/B/C segments of 440/660/880 Hz, one 4/4 bar each at 120 BPM; loop orientation/content identifiers, not a measured resampling oracle

authored_midi.events: Use explicit note-on/off pairs with admitted channel/note/velocity in a valid editable source MIDI clip. Single-note A then overlapping B; for voice-boundary cases use distinct held notes up to named voice count then one extra. Release all notes between trials.
authored_midi.limitations: No MIDI byte codec, pitch-frequency mapping, voice allocation, stealing or ordering is supplied by this recipe.
